day.headline: A Pig day — Rabbit and Goat are in step.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a slide deck at forty percent
signs.message: Forty percent is plenty to show someone. Share it this morning.

reasons: Rabbit and Pig share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: You lifted that take from someone. Use it today, no footnote.

reasons: Tiger pairs with Pig — a harmonious day
signs.message: Say the half-thought out loud. Let someone else finish it.

reasons: Goat and Pig share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Pick them up on your way out. Hallway looks intentional.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You quietly settled for fine on that one. Nudge it back.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a hem that needs taking up
signs.message: Take it to the tailor near the studio. Cheap, quick fix.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Your jaw's been clenched since the alarm. Let it hang loose.

reasons: Pig's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Bill got split like nobody was watching. Mention it, lightly, today.

reasons: Snake opposes Pig — a day to take slowly
signs.message: It shouldn't run and it does. Don't investigate, leave it alone.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a ticket barrier that will not open
signs.message: The gate's not budging. Someone in a vest handles this, not you.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Good light all morning and no plans in it. Perfect, stay.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Pull in, terrible coffee, sit in the car a while.
